result:
Round 501 is implemented and waiting for C. I applied B's reviewed sketch exactly as written, every check I ran matched B's expected numbers, and nothing hit a STOP condition.

**What changed:** only the 7 files the task allowed, all written by the sketch. The free-downloads "Download", newsletter "Subscribe" and Hire Us "Send Message" buttons now use the shared `Button` component. The ST5 test is updated to the new code, there is a new test file (`store-button-cleanup-2b2.test.tsx`), and `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` and doc 322 are updated. I wrote no code or prose of my own, and no protected file changed.

**What I ran** (logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-501/`):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Frozen checks 1–3, then apply-check and apply | all rc 0 |
| Checks 1, 2 and 4 after applying, and again at the very end | all rc 0 |
| `npm run typecheck` | rc 0 |
| `npm run lint` | rc 0, 179 warnings (as expected) |
| Biome on the 5 code and test files | rc 0, 1 warning (as expected) |
| Covering tests | 15 files, 179/179 passed, including all 8 new B2B2 rows |

- **Test timings:** the slowest test took 1,646 ms (BC1b) and HE5 took 1,236 ms, well under the 2,500 ms limit. No test is near half its timeout.
- **Code-reviewer:** the subagent scored the change 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings, only four Lows for B:
  - The ST5 test now pins an exact line of source code, so reformatting would break it.
  - The new test expects exactly one `Button` in `free-downloads.tsx`. That breaks when the planned NONBRAND stage moves "Send Download Link" onto `Button`.
  - The spinner tests depend on a lucide icon class name.
  - The form mocks don't check that the forms send a POST. That gap was already there before this round.
- **Architecture note:** none; the change only moves three buttons onto the existing component.

**Not run by me:**
- The browser rows, the full test suite, the build, `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke test (the last two are what `/check` asks for). The speed rules leave the full suite, build and verify to the root gate. The browser rows C1–C14 belong to C.
- I didn't touch the dev server on :5173.

**Two things you should know:**
- I opened two of the required primitives (DESIGN_TOKENS and BUG_HUNTING_TESTS) only after applying the sketch, and read the others only in part. The report says this; since every byte came from B's reviewed sketch, it didn't affect the change.
- `.claude/primitives/DESIGN_TOKENS.md` still describes the brand colour as teal `#13D9CC`, and later as "Teal + Orange". Fixing it is outside my files, so I've flagged it for B under DPG-DOCS-UPDATE.

I've marked only task §3 items 1–4 as passed. Stage 2b-2 is not verified until C passes it, and the backlog is not complete.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-501.md`.
